Untattered.name: Untattered
Untattered.text: Complete The Tatterdemalion with no cards left in the scanning deck.

AirlockSequence.name: Airlock Sequence
AirlockSequence.text: Defeat three enemies using the ability on Escape Pod Bay in The Tatterdemalion.

MentalFortitude.name: Mental Fortitude
MentalFortitude.text: Defeat the Shadow of Thoughts in Electric Nightmare.

BrainBurn.name: Brain Burn
BrainBurn.text: Defeat the Boogeyman in Electric Nightmare while spending fewer than 6 clues per investigator during the scenario.

OutOfTime.name: Out of Time
OutOfTime.text: Defeat all three copies of Hound of Tindalos in Lost Quantum.

SaviorOfNostalgia.name: Savior of Nostalgia
SaviorOfNostalgia.text: Save 5 or more Crew story assets and defeat the Entity in In the Shadow of Earth.

Neuroscientist.name: Neuroscientist
Neuroscientist.text: Complete Strange Moons with no cards left in the scanning deck and no damage on any Brain story asset.

SelfHelp.name: Self Help
SelfHelp.text: Defeat all copies of Your Other Self without spending clues during the last act of The Machine in Yellow.

Endtimes.name: Endtimes
Endtimes.text: Win the Dark Matter campaign with 4 Elder Thing tokens, 3 Tablet tokens, and no Elder Sign token in the chaos bag at the end.

ItsTooLate.name: It's Too Late
ItsTooLate.text: Win the Dark Matter campaign with 12 or more Impending Doom.

LineInTheSky.name: Line in the Sky
LineInTheSky.text: Win the Dark Matter campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

TheHeirToCarcosa.name: The Heir to Carcosa
TheHeirToCarcosa.text: Win the Dark Matter campaign on Expert difficulty by defeating Tassilda in Starfall.
